definitions.explanation: Questioning of a suspect or witness by the police or prosecutors; more broadly, an official inquiry into a matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: To be questioned by the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The questioning of the suspect is continuing.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A system for video-recording interrogations was introduced.

notes:
The noun of {取|と}り{調|しら}べる (to investigate, to question). Most often police or prosecutors questioning a suspect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be questioned
- {取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧: to submit to questioning
- {取|と}り{調|しら}べ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧: interrogation room
- ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{調|しら}べ: voluntary questioning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尋問|じんもん}→尋問：31614_jinmon⟧: formal questioning, as of a witness in court
- {事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}: interview of a witness or person concerned (softer than {取|と}り{調|しら}べ)
